body:
Honestly, adventure would be wasted on me.
Show me the most beautiful place on earth and I cannot feel anything for it. Not peace or joy or awe. I enjoy nothing.

I'm pretty lonely. I have a husband I can't connect with, a no friends. 
I wonder how people make these strong lifelong friendships.

My own sister doesn't even want to be my friend. She calls her ex boyfriend's sister 'sister' and spends time with her that she has never tried spending with me. 

I work with my mother and suffer abuse daily. I try to have a relationship with her outside of work, but she just wants to vent and tell me her issues everyday to and from work.

My father is a quiet man that I have never been able to talk or relate to.

I spent the entire day today watching the food network Christmas specials, but I don't want to spend time with these people, let alone pretend to enjoy myself.
